Open the deck [in its own tab](../../slides/eu-frames-full.html){target="_blank"} for the full screen, the speaker view and the keyboard controls: the `d` key switches the optional runs on and off, `[` and `]` jump between parts, and `g` opens a jump bar that finds a slide by its title.
